notes.title: Patch note 1.1.0 - Orion
notes.content:
Sorry for keep you waiting, the Orion has come! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/6dcee48201539a8838814639b060325c3875a16f.png[/img]

[b]Dacapo[/b]
[b]Main Weapon[/b] : Bird Strike - Dacapo releases illusion bird in mouse direction dealing damage to all hit enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/012544efd6727f6abe4408e4d17b959e5c1ac51f.gif[/img]
[b]Skill[/b] : Awakening of Sacred Bird - Whenever Dacapo collects 5 rosaries, he will transform into Sacred bird form incredibly increasing speed and calling Daca's uncle for assistance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/8af263a7a39f32524e5c1826b338ff5f9c9a0f7b.gif[/img]

[b]Baabel[/b]
[b]Main Weapon[/b] : Holy Beam - Baabel uses divine power to summon the light of God to attack enemies at the mouse position
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/788cff3cc616f4f618cf893cdda8f7795f82065d.gif[/img]
[b]Skill[/b] : Awakening of Baphomet - Whenever Baabel defeats 30 enemies, he will transform into Baphomet. His weapon will change from Holy Beam to Dark Beam, and he will attack continuously without cooldown.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/e4b8eb3a1f78dae720008adbcee2e2f80850ae6d.gif[/img]

[b]Schneider [/b]
[b]Main Weapon[/b] : Cthulhu call - Schneider summons Cthulhu from his Grimoire based on the mouse position. The summoned Cthulhu can be in various direction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/78f2fa3f7034a06ce7945751b19e1252ff221fe8.gif[/img]
[b]Skill[/b] : Awakening of Darkhold - Every once in a while, Cthulhu will throw the Book of Darkness for you, which, when picked up, will grant you various effect.

Red Grimoire >> increases ATK damage
Blue Grimoire >> increases ATK speed
Green Grimoire >> increases Move speed
Gold Grimoire >> increases pick up radius
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/fa803d8f89c41d1ee9beb8f540d9e84ea420adb1.gif[/img]

notes.title: Patch note 1.0.0 Full release - Gen 3 & New map
notes.content:
This patch will include

[b]New playable characters with their new abilities[/b]
Gen 3 Illusion is coming to the game with new abilities to "Transform" themselves.
Change their weapons based on situations.

[b]Ayna[/b] - Donk's Designer Mirror Girl
[b]Listen[/b] - Beautiful Voice Gramophone
[b]Baku[/b] - Your Neighbourhood Dreameater
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/c7ff2a83aef6f0c6fa47fbbd1fd4ffe66ba456c0.png[/img]

[b]New map[/b]
Map 2: Eclipse, with new challenged enemies and new songs in Gen 2 theme.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/7ce0264e59a6a1bc1fed5a57ed1897f7907b1e54.png[/img]

[b]Re-designed UIs[/b]
New UIs which are designed to be functional and go with the game.

More works on game optimization.

notes.title: Patch note 0.3.0
notes.content:
In this patch, we add some logic and balance adjusting to encourage you to use items other than sustainable items which have played very important role since the game is published.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Now player will restore some HP when level up. We hope that this healing will give player more choice to play around.
[/list]

[b]Balance adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduce Selene weapon LV 7 healing amount.
[*] Increase Backpatch effect percentage.
[/list]

[b]Apocalypse map[/b]
[list]
[*] Change some building on the map.
[*] Rework art and hitbox of obstacle which hard to be seen.
[*] Increase the size of hitbox that make obstacles fade when player near them.
[/list]

[b]Weapon[/b]
[list]
[*] Rework Solar weapon LV7 flare art.
[*] Rework Zenith rapier effect art.
[*] Rework Ryuusei-ken art.
[/list]

[b]Enemy[/b]
[list]
[*] Rework Outer god art and size.
[/list]

notes.title: Major patch 0.2 is now available.
notes.content:
Hi! everyone, we come back with the new major feature Encore mode!

[b]Encore mode[/b]
Here come our new feature, Encore mode. Encore mode will be available, when player clear the stage once. Players can encore after they defeat the boss. After encore, the game will continue with the random song, and now the game will last long until player die.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/68fe378b9de460ef1f8dd98a5db118106c2e2915.png[/img]

[b]Mouse Intregration[/b]
Dragon claw, S1R beam, Star sword, Base bonk bat, Atlaz arc, Knuckle and Meteor now can be controlled by mouse.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/595229dc5f0047a9dc8385ae03be53fbcdc135f0.png[/img]

Addition UI that makes mouse usage more comfortable have been included.
[i]Take note that we change only default control, so players who have played the game have to change the control in settings.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/6ec8875fa98579bb9160f05cbb4b55fc17119bad.png[/img]

[b]Quality of life[/b]
Weapon opacity is now able to be adjusted in setting.
